flows.title: Global Search Purpose
flows.reason: Section 12 Search is a derived scoped view; no source-owned mutation exists in Search. Architecture inspection and command tests confirm navigation/findability only.

flows.title: Desktop Search Entry
flows.reason: Persistent labelled shell Search uses an actor/access-bound memory handoff; no query enters URL or history payload. Real desktop shell entry verified.

flows.title: Mobile Full-Screen Search Entry
flows.reason: A dedicated full-height mobile page with labelled Search input, stacked controls and compact global header was tested at 320/390/768 widths; no bottom navigation.

flows.title: Keyboard Search Shortcut
flows.reason: Ctrl/Meta K focuses the desktop shell entry or opens mobile Search, respects an open modal and removes its listener on unmount. Real keyboard shortcut verified.

flows.title: Search Input / Trigger Behaviour
flows.reason: Two-character free-text threshold or explicit submission, 200-character bound, entity filtering and immediate submitted exact lookup; no query history.

flows.title: Recent Authorized Entities
flows.reason: At most five actor-bound entity handles are retained in session storage without labels/PII/query text. Current owner read and authorization precede each displayed preview and subsequent open.

flows.title: Customer Search
flows.reason: No trusted staff-safe Customer read/search contract exists. customerProfiles is customer-owned with self-only rules and no independent Account state, public reference, field-purpose projection or lifecycle source.

flows.title: Main Order / Extension Search
flows.reason: No Main Order/Extension owner service, stable-reference resolver, collections/rules or destination workflow exists; a Search grant does not manufacture that source.

flows.title: Payment Search
flows.reason: No Payment record/reference/review service exists. Search exposes an authorized source-unavailable state, never proof or fake financial data.

flows.title: Chat Search
flows.reason: General Chat findability and exact existing-ID open are backed. Main Order Chat linkage, durable human-readable Chat references and authorized Customer-to-Chat name lookup remain owner dependencies.

flows.title: Product Search
flows.reason: Scoped catalogue names/status are searchable in paginated loaded summaries and known IDs resolve directly. Complete all-page text/reference indexing and approved human-readable reference resolution remain unimplemented owner read-model dependencies; no claim of complete Product Search.

flows.title: Review / Dicta Moment Search
flows.reason: Legacy Review state previews/exact lookup are backed, but the canonical Review/Dicta Moment source, public reference and complete search contract are not present.

flows.title: Custom Style Search
flows.reason: No structured Custom Style request/reference/service exists. Only independently authorized source-unavailable Search status is exposed.

flows.title: Search Result Grouping & Preview
flows.reason: Results group by authorized entity type with minimum metadata, semantic h2/h3/list structure and bounded pagination. Missing owner domains are separately unavailable, not fake result groups.

flows.title: Permission-Aware Search
flows.reason: Inherited current Staff Access/capability/purpose/complete-route scope is enforced in Firestore before retrieval. Narrow-scope, denied-deep-link and revocation tests pass.

flows.title: Sensitive-Data Masking in Search
flows.reason: Broad previews omit internal IDs, contact, transcripts, Review bodies/private media and Payment evidence. REST field masks limit payloads; scoped response privacy tests and real network checks pass.

flows.title: Exact Identifier / Reference Search
flows.reason: Known existing object IDs resolve directly beyond page one and are not displayed broadly. Authoritative human-readable Customer/Order/Extension/Payment/Chat/Review reference resolvers do not exist; guessing mappings would violate owner identity.

flows.title: Search Deep-Link Routing
flows.reason: Each backed open rereads exact current owner context and rechecks authority before routing; Product/Review/General Chat destination rules remain independent. Unbacked exact routes fail explicitly, without substitute objects.

flows.title: No-Results Behaviour
flows.reason: No results in successfully checked loaded pages is distinct from partial/unavailable/loading; coverage never implies all-page search exhaustion.

flows.title: Search Error / Unavailable Behaviour
flows.reason: Independent source states, checked-time metadata, read Retry and bounded page loading preserve query and healthy results. Synthetic isolated Review read outage/retry was tested without blanking Product results.

flows.title: Stale Search Result Behaviour
flows.reason: Inherited exact current owner re-resolution defeats stale projections. Attention resolved-elsewhere and Chat reassignment runtime checks validate no stale consequential shortcut.

flows.title: Search Index vs Authoritative Truth
flows.reason: Loaded summaries are explicitly projections, not indexes/business truth. Current owner reads/rules govern each use; no Search-owned mutable business state.

flows.title: Natural-Language Search
flows.reason: A deterministic bounded parser supports entity/name phrases and chats-waiting-on-staff without AI, new provider, hidden broad retrieval or mutation. Unsupported phrases are literal find queries, not invented answers.

flows.title: Universal / Command Search
flows.reason: Only explicit safe navigation commands and exact owner opens are interpreted. Consequential verbs remain literal find queries; current staff and exact target checks are independent.

flows.title: Search Validation & Module Handoff
flows.reason: 25 official flows are dispositioned; full Search validation/handoff is blocked by missing owner projections, references, complete index/rate/abuse contracts and transaction journeys.

flows.reason: No owner-controlled eligibility/assignment queue or concurrent protected assignment endpoint exists; no second assignment engine was added.

flows.title: No Eligible Couturier State
flows.reason: No owner eligibility source can establish that zero eligible Couturiers exist. Source absence is not displayed as a fabricated zero-eligibility state.

flows.title: Chat Attention Card
flows.reason: Inherited derived Chat Attention uses current minimal parent state; exact preflight detects resolution elsewhere and reconciles without duplicate work.

flows.title: Exact Open Chat Action
flows.reason: Backed exact General Chat open independently checks current server owner state and read authority; stale tab loses private context after authoritative reassignment.

flows.title: Main Order / Extension Chat Context
flows.reason: The codebase has customer-keyed General Chat only, not durable dedicated Main Order/Extension Chat linkage. Creating a second identity/path without the owner technical integration would violate Section 14/16 lineage.

flows.title: Generic Assistance Chat Context
flows.reason: General assistance is explicitly labelled and cannot grant unrelated Main Order access. No transaction deep link or assignment is inferred from participation.

flows.title: Dormant / Completed Conversation Behaviour
flows.reason: No authoritative conversation dormancy/completion lifecycle is stored. It is not inferred from sender, age or an empty transcript.

flows.title: Extension Reactivation of Existing Context
flows.reason: No Extension owner exists to reactivate a dedicated Main Order Chat. No clone/delete/relabel operation exists; exact reactivation remains an owner dependency.

flows.title: Chat Message Preview Privacy
flows.reason: Inbox now retrieves minimal scoped REST summaries instead of full parent payloads; no contact/raw UID/transcript appears in broad preview. Exact authorized workspace separately retrieves transcript.

flows.title: Chat Permission Boundaries
flows.reason: Current access, exact read/reply capabilities, purpose and current assignedStaffId are independently enforced in rules; revoked assignment cannot read/write protected children. Runtime transfer and deny tests pass.

flows.title: Chat in Customer Summary / Search Boundary
flows.reason: Search-to-General-Chat is safe and backed. Customer Summary-to-Chat and transaction relationship integration remain unavailable because the Customer/transaction owners are absent.

flows.title: Desktop Chat Visibility
flows.reason: Desktop and rail layouts retain independent scoped Inbox and exact General Chat workspace; runtime verification covers 900/1024/1280/1440/1920 without overflow.

flows.title: Mobile Chat Visibility
flows.reason: Mobile/card transformation preserves current privacy/reply semantics and reachable composer/back control; runtime checks cover 320/390/768 without horizontal overflow.

flows.title: Chat Concurrency / Handled-Elsewhere Behaviour
flows.reason: Actor-bound logical-message markers survive reopening/session reload; exact immutable receipt validates actor,target,action,outcome before clearing. Unknown absence/unavailability blocks blind resend. Service tests and emulator/browser sends, transfer and recovery pass.

flows.title: Chat Operations Validation & Module Handoff
flows.reason: 22 official flows are dispositioned; full Chat handoff is blocked by dedicated Main Order linkage, unread/lifecycle/eligibility/assignment/reactivation owner contracts and transaction journeys.
